<thought>The mass and ¹H NMR indicate a C₁₄H₁₂O₆ molecule containing an ethyl ester (quartet at 4.30 ppm, triplet at 1.29 ppm) and seven aromatic protons. Among the isomers returned, the SMILES `CCOC(=O)C1=C(OC2=C1C=C(C=C2)O)C3OC=CO3` matches these features: it has an ethyl COOCH₂CH₃ group, a phenolic OH, and a fused dioxole ring, giving a total of six oxygens and the correct number of aromatic protons. This is the most consistent candidate with the experimental data.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)C1=C(OC2=C1C=C(C=C2)O)C3OC=CO3</final_answer>
